name: Poison Tips
summary: Neza Bloodsnout wants Glade Viper venom from the pools south of Rog'mar. She plans to coat arrows with it, though the poison ruins the meat.

sections.title: A Deadly Coating
sections.body: Poison can make an arrow more potent, though it spoils the meat. Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar believes you can gather venom from the vipers by the pools to the south. Their venom is dangerous to handle, so care matters as you collect it.

faq.answer: Neza Bloodsnout at Rog'mar wants Glade Viper venom.
Neza plans to use the venom as a poison coating for arrows.

faq.q: Where does the venom come from?
faq.answer: The Glade Vipers by the pools to the south produce the venom.
Poison coatings make arrows more potent against prey, but ruin the meat.

faq.q: Is Glade Viper venom dangerous to gather?
faq.answer: Yes. Neza warns that you could succumb to the vipers' venom while gathering it.
